blocks.content: Whenever I have something I want to understand, I tend to write a small game or simulation to help me. Over the years I have accumulated a collection of small app experiments based on concepts in areas such as physics, philosophy, economics, machine learning, and biology. Not all of these are worth sharing but I have decided I will try and clean a few up to be presentable in case others find them interesting. I also have made a few simple games to play with my kids and family, tools I find I need, and software to accompany some of my mechanical creations. Here  is where I am now posting some these little software projects.
